verdict.rationale: Lambda lets you copy files to and from your filesystems with standard S3-compatible tools such as rclone and s5cmd, and gives SSH access to instances. Workloads run on standard Ubuntu, Kubernetes and Slurm with no long-term commitments, so leaving is practical. However, there is no documented account-wide export or offboarding process, so getting everything out is a do-it-yourself job. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, guidance on exporting instance disks or images, data-deletion and offboarding guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful migration off Lambda.
